snippet.title: Kotobuki Grand Prix PAL PS1 Longplay - Trash Racing Game
snippet.description:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL-_dl5TFEwyelK47LZ8vGOIpYAYrhQeMq
another garbage pal conversion from midas without voices and cutscenes, original japanese version was running in 20fps but this one is 25 fps, guess what because of higher framerate game is broken, enemies always faster than you and you got broken handling that even worse than original, it's possible to play this version only with bicycle girl and max handling, original japanese version sucks too but more playable than this shit
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WE-ytEu1V6A - better jap version
